Privacy notice

How this website handles information

Effective 1 November 2026. This notice covers the public Sankofa Digital ZA website and its enquiry links.

Website operation

This is a static informational website. It does not create user accounts, run advertising, use analytics, set tracking cookies or store enquiry form submissions in a website database.

Enquiries

The contact form prepares a message in your email application or WhatsApp. You decide whether to send it. Once sent, the relevant email or messaging provider processes the message under its own terms and privacy practices.

Sankofa Digital ZA may use the information you send to understand your enquiry, respond, assess whether the work is a fit and maintain a reasonable record of the business conversation.

Information you may provide

  • Your name and email address.
  • Your organisation.
  • The type and stage of the proposed project.
  • Information included in your description of the problem or opportunity.

Do not include passwords, identity documents, payment-card details, confidential employee records or sensitive operational evidence in an initial enquiry.

Service and hosting records

The hosting provider and network infrastructure may process routine technical records needed to deliver and protect the website, such as request timestamps, IP addresses, user-agent information and security events. Sankofa Digital ZA does not use those records for behavioural advertising.

Sharing and retention

Enquiry information is shared only as needed to respond, assess or deliver the requested work, meet a legal obligation or protect legitimate rights. Information is retained only for as long as reasonably required for those purposes.

Your choices

You may ask what personal information Sankofa Digital ZA holds about your enquiry, request correction or deletion where applicable, or object to continued use. Requests can be sent to sankofa.digital.studios@gmail.com.

Changes

This notice may change when the website adds new features or providers. The effective date at the top identifies the current version.
